q.p: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.t: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.o: Return to the Scholomance with the Blood of Innocents. Find the porch and place the Blood of Innocents in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul. Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to Eva Sarkhoff.

q.p: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.t: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.o: Locate Jandice Barov in the Scholomance and destroy her. From her corpse recover Krastinov's Bag of Horrors. Return the bag to Eva Sarkhoff.

q.p: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.t: Eva Sarkhoff, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.o: Find Doctor Theolen Krastinov inside the Scholomance. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of Eva Sarkhoff and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to Eva Sarkhoff when the task is complete.

q.p: Magistrate Marduke, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.t: Magistrate Marduke, Caer Darrow, Western Plaguelands
q.o: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the Scholomance. When you have found him, use the Soulbound Keepsake on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the Human Head of Ras Frostwhisper. Take the head back to Magistrate Marduke.

q.p: Weldon Barov, Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands
q.t: Weldon Barov, Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands
q.o: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Weldon Barov when you have completed this task.

q.p: Alexi Barov, The Bulwark, Tirisfal Glades
q.t: Alexi Barov, The Bulwark, Tirisfal Glades
q.o: Venture to the Scholomance and recover the Barov family fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: The Deed to Caer Darrow; The Deed to Brill; The Deed to Tarren Mill; and The Deed to Southshore. Return to Alexi Barov when you have completed this task.

q.p: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
q.t: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
q.o: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

q.p: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
q.t: Betina Bigglezink, Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands
q.o: Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.

q.p: Gorzeeki Wildeyes, Altar of Storms, Burning Steppes
q.t: Gorzeeki Wildeyes, Altar of Storms, Burning Steppes
q.o: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

q.p: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, Cathedral of Light, Stormwind
q.o: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver. Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger. Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

q.p: Sagorne Creststrider, Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar
q.t: Sagorne Creststrider, Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar
q.o: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance. Doing so will bring forth spirits you must fight. Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver; defeat him. Bring Darkreaver's Head to Sagorne Creststrider in the Valley of Wisdom, Orgrimmar.

d.tx: An ancient titan facility in the northern hills of Un'Goro Crater, overlooking dinosaurs, tar pits and powerful crystals. Collect power crystals across Un'Goro and use them at the consoles inside the terrace.

ent.t: Northern rim of Un'Goro Crater, on the hill right above Marshal's Refuge: climb the stairs to the titan temple

b.w: Two raptors, fought together. Not elite.

q.o: Bring Mayena Earthseeker a Moist Crystal, a Charged Crystal, a Noxious Crystal and a Fiery Crystal from Shaper's Terrace.
Gather 8 Seeping Slime Essence in the Shaper's Terrace.

q.t: Master Apothecary Faranell, The Apothecarium, Undercity (48.8, 69.3)
q.o: Gather a colorless Drained Crystal Fragment near the Achromatic Crystal in the Shaper's Terrace.

q.t: Curator Thorius, Hall of Explorers, Ironforge (71.5, 15.7)
q.o: Slay Venomridge, 6 Ravasaur Matriarchs and 8 Ironhide Ravasaurs in Shaper's Terrace.

q.p: Curator Thorius, Hall of Explorers, Ironforge (71.5, 15.7)
q.t: Curator Thorius, Hall of Explorers, Ironforge (71.5, 15.7)
q.o: Find Interesting Landmarks in Shaper's Terrace and fill out the explorer's map at each: the Pillar of Assimilation, the Achromatic Crystal, the Western Gates, the Regrowth Vestibule and the Unearthed Stone Watcher.

q.p: The Partially Digested Journal lying on the ground inside Shaper's Terrace (the Verdant Plains): click it to get the quest

q.o: Collect 15 Partially Digested Journal Pages in Shaper's Terrace.
